timeline.text: Every lesson in a language app was written by one shared AI subscription — burn its quota, and every other project sharing it stalled too.
Now a button copies the lesson prompt, so any outside AI can answer instead — like hiring any freelancer, not just the one under contract.
A Cloudflare Worker reads that pasted answer straight into vocabulary words and dialogue lines, not a generic text dump.
It only trusts that paste once it counts at least 3.
